summary: Sync ad-groups and ads as parent-keyed dependents scoped by a query parameter, and restore both to the default sync set.
reason: The generator emitted ad-groups and ads as flat top-level resources and omitted them from defaultSyncResources(). The vendor spec marks campaign_id required on GET /ad_groups and ad_group_id required on GET /ads, so a flat sync stored no parent linkage and only appeared to work on a single-campaign account. dependentResourceDef supported only PathTemplate substitution, and /campaigns/{id}/ad_groups returns HTTP 404 because the parent link is a query parameter, not a path segment. Added a ParentQueryParam field and injected it into request params.
validated_outcome: Live sync against a real ad account now completes with 9 resources and persists ad_groups.campaign_id and ads.ad_group_id; previously it emitted a 404 sync_error for every campaign.
